audience: insurance agencies that track leads and appointments in Max CRM

useCases.title: Check this week's appointments
useCases.text: List the appointments of the week, with their lead. Open a lead to see its contact details and status.

useCases.title: Review a lead's history
useCases.text: Read one lead and its notes. Then read the account activity feed for recent calls, texts and status changes.

useCases.title: Add a new lead
useCases.text: Read the allowed statuses and lead types first. Then create the lead with a phone number and a name.

useCases.title: Move a lead to another status
useCases.text: Update the status of a lead. Add a note that records the reason for the change.
